true_false_rapid_fire.statement: Aristotle and Plato laid the groundwork for logical reasoning.
true_false_rapid_fire.explanation: Aristotle and Plato were ancient philosophers who contributed significantly to the development of logical reasoning.

true_false_rapid_fire.statement: The English language has only one type of tense.
true_false_rapid_fire.explanation: The English language has three primary categories of tenses: present, past, and future.

true_false_rapid_fire.statement: Graphs are used only for mathematical data analysis.
true_false_rapid_fire.explanation: Graphs are visual representations of data and can be used for various types of data analysis, including non-mathematical data.
